<style>
  #title-block-header { display: none; }

  body.quarto-light .navbar-brand .navbar-title { font-weight: 700; color: #0f3b5f; }

  #home-h .hero-band { position: relative; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 100vw;
    margin-top: -1.875rem; padding: 1.5rem 1.5rem 2rem; text-align: center; z-index: 2;
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.75) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 60%),

    border-bottom: 1px solid #dbe7f0; }
  #home-h .hero-band .waves { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; }
  #home-h .hero-band .waves path { fill: none; stroke: #1b4f72; stroke-width: 1.5; opacity: .08; }
  #home-h .hero-inner { position: relative; max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
  #home-h .hero-inner img { height: min(150px, 15vh); width: auto; max-width: 100%; }
  #home-h .headline { font-size: 2.2rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; color: #0f3b5f;
    max-width: 900px; margin: .5rem auto .5rem; text-wrap: balance; }
  #home-h .intro { font-size: 1.25rem; color: #3d4a56; max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto 1rem; text-wrap: balance; }
  #home-h .intro a { color: #0f3b5f; font-weight: 500; }

  /* "Our Lab philosophy": small outlined pill; full text pops up on hover / tap / focus */
  #home-h .philo-trigger { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem;
    padding: .45rem 1.3rem; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 500; color: #0f3b5f; cursor: help;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.7); border: 1.5px solid #0f3b5f; border-radius: 10px; outline: none;
    transition: background .2s ease; }
  #home-h .philo-trigger:hover, #home-h .philo-trigger:focus { background: #fff; }
  #home-h .philo-pop { position: absolute; top: calc(100% + .7rem); left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -6px);
    width: min(640px, 84vw); padding: 1rem 1.25rem; text-align: left; font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.45; color: #333; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #d5e2ec; border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(15,59,95,.18); opacity: 0; visibility: hidden;
    transition: opacity .2s ease, transform .2s ease, visibility .2s; z-index: 20; cursor: auto; }
  #home-h .philo-trigger:hover .philo-pop,
  #home-h .philo-trigger:focus .philo-pop,
  #home-h .philo-trigger:focus-within .philo-pop { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: translate(-50%, 0); }

  /* ── Bottom section: "What we do" cards ───────────────────────────── */
  #home-h .lower { position: relative; z-index: 1; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: min(1500px, 88vw);

    margin: 0 0 1rem; }
  #home-h .cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 1.25rem; }
  @media (max-width: 1199.98px) { #home-h .cards { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }
  @media (max-width: 575.98px) { #home-h .cards { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  #home-h .card-x { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #d9e4ec; border-top: 4px solid #0f3b5f; border-radius: 10px;
    padding: .9rem 1.4rem 1.1rem; transition: box-shadow .2s ease, transform .2s ease; }

  #home-h .card-x p { margin: 0; font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1.45; color: #3d4a56; }

  body.quarto-dark #home-h .philo-trigger:hover, body.quarto-dark #home-h .philo-trigger:focus { background: rgba(0,0,0,.35); }
  body.quarto-dark #home-h .philo-pop { color: #e9ecef; background: #2b3035; border-color: #495057;

  body.quarto-dark #home-h .card-x { background: #2b3035; border-color: #495057; border-top-color: #5dade2; }
  body.quarto-dark #home-h .card-x .icon { background: rgba(93,173,226,.15); color: #5dade2; }
</style>

    <span class="philo-trigger" tabindex="0"><i class="bi bi-lightbulb"></i>Our Lab philosophy
